description: CRIT-205 requires that for each of the 31 targeted PROP IDs (including PROP-201c, explicitly named in the contract's own 'Deferred-obligation disposition' 31-item list), 'a read of its own verification method (in verification-architecture.md) against the current spawn-orchestrator.mjs/gen-solana-wallet.sh/run.sh source confirms the named call site/function genuinely exists and is reachable ... FAIL if any of the 31 names a call site that does not exist in the current implementation, is unreachable, or is a stub/placeholder'. PROP-201c's own verification-method text (specs/verification-architecture.md line 461, unchanged since round-3's own FIND-007b) reads: 'Tier 0: structural read of the calling code confirms stdout is redirected directly to a file path, never piped through any logging wrapper; Tier 2: a real invocation's gen-wallet.sh output file has mode 0600 and lives under the child's own home'. This describes a mechanism -- a shell-level stdout redirect of gen-wallet.sh's own output directly to a 600-perm file -- that does NOT exist anywhere in the current implementation and never has. defaultGenerateEvmWallet (spawn-orchestrator.mjs lines 147-152) captures gen-wallet.sh's stdout purely in-memory via execFileSync's return value (`const out = execFileSync("bash", [GEN_WALLET_SCRIPT], { encoding: "utf8" })`) -- there is no file redirect of any kind at that call site, so there is no 'gen-wallet.sh output file' for Tier 0's or Tier 2's named check to find. The round-3 fix (commit 31e36c9) instead added a genuinely NEW, differently-shaped function, defaultPersistChildWallet (lines 168-179), which separately re-serializes the in-memory {address, privateKey} pair into a DIFFERENT file (childHomeDir/.automaton/wallet.json, camelCase field names) at a later point in the call sequence (immediately after step 2, not as part of gen-wallet.sh's own invocation). The underlying SECURITY GOAL PROP-201c's own left-hand description states (private key material captured only into a 600-perm file under the child's own home, never a shared log) is genuinely met by this new mechanism and is genuinely tested (spawn-orchestrator-gas-seed-and-key-persistence.test.mjs lines 83/139 assert mode 0o600 on the actual wallet.json path) -- this is NOT a functional/security gap. But the verification METHOD text itself, as literally written, names a call site ('gen-wallet.sh output file', 'stdout is redirected directly to a file path') that a verifier executing Phase 3/5's promotion-to-proved step could not actually perform, because that call site does not exist. This exact mismatch was already identified in round-3's own FIND-007 ('arguably the in-memory-only approach is a MORE conservative security posture than PROP-201c's own file-based design, but that is a reason to correct verification-architecture.md's own text, not a substitute for it currently existing') -- the round-3 fix closed the IMPLEMENTATION gap (adding defaultPersistChildWallet) but never made the companion verification-architecture.md text correction FIND-007 itself called for, leaving PROP-201c's own row (and its two Purity Boundary Map cross-references at lines 560 and 666) stale and pointing at a nonexistent mechanism.

evidence.snippet: | PROP-201c | REQ-201 | Private key material is captured only into a 600-perm file under the child's own isolated `$HOME`, never into a shared log | 0/2 | true | Tier 0: structural read of the calling code confirms stdout is redirected directly to a file path, never piped through any logging wrapper; Tier 2: a real invocation's `gen-wallet.sh` output file has mode `0600` and lives under the child's own home |
